observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D7100' clearly visible on the top and front respectively.
The camera is placed in front of a worn cardboard box with a yellow Nikon logo.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from a side angle, held in hand, with the lens cap removed and resting beside it.
The camera body appears to be in used condition with some scuffs and wear, especially on the grip and body.
The box in the background has 'D7100' printed on it, matching the camera model.

The seller claims to include 2 batteries and a silicone case, but these are not shown.
